name: Cookie Consent
description: An accessible GDPR cookie banner in Dutch or English, with accept, reject and per-category settings. It remembers the choice and tells other scripts through a data attribute and a DOM event.

panels.title: Cookie consent
panels.description: The cookie banner shown to visitors who have not made a choice yet. Dutch pages get the Dutch text, every other page the English one.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show the cookie banner
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: message-en
fields.title: Text (English)
fields.description: Leave it empty for the default text.

fields.name: message-nl
fields.title: Text (Dutch)
fields.description: Shown on pages whose language is Dutch. Leave it empty for the default text.

fields.name: policy-url
fields.title: Privacy policy link
fields.description: A path such as /privacy or a full https:// address. Leave it empty to show no link.

fields.name: accent
fields.title: Button colour
fields.description: The button text turns dark or light by itself to stay readable.

fields.name: reopen
fields.title: Show a small "Cookies" button after a choice
fields.description: Lets visitors change their mind. You can also add data-cookie-settings to any link or button of your own.
